decision: Retain an offline handoff harness. Capture/store and original retry contracts are qualified for the declared synthetic cases; shared 429 cooldown creates eight local deferrals without HTTP and requires versioned admission/lineage before adoption. Final test selection requires an explicit frozen inventory; absent optional fixtures skip rather than failing ordinary test runs.
falsifier: Changed source or raw bytes, fabricated earlier receipt availability, altered persisted rows, missing attempts or false shared physical-call accounting would invalidate the reported contract. Full scheduling and study migration remain unqualified.
hypothesis: The real service can deliver into all five actual frozen capture/store implementations while preserving receipt and storage evidence; admission and transport accounting differences must remain explicit.
limitations: Research relay, synthetic candles and empty response headers; no current trading data or financial outcomes.
Native original _capture admission path is exercised, but full scheduling and durable slot reservation are not.
Earlier consent of 1000ms is explicit proposed fixture behavior; original collector consent is not assumed.
Direct fabricated HTTP is serialized by the parent; these cases are not a latency benchmark.
Full cancellation, lost acknowledgement, API-return expiry, other query kinds, headers, large responses, adaptation, restart and study migration remain unqualified.
Original local raw schemas still see deferral as a failed local call; physical transport lineage is separate research evidence, not an installed accounting repair.
Coverage percentages have not been measured and this harness is not qualified production adapter code.
No live approval or deployment is requested.
